hypothesis: On NCAAF games that are lopsided (|closing home spread| >= 28) or FBS-vs-FCS, the final total exceeds the ESPN closing total on average: mean(actual total - closing total) > 0.
origin_note: The tilt was found retrospectively (55.2% over on 972 games before registration). That history is cited only as the origin of the hypothesis and is never part of a test; it includes 2026-11-14.

evaluation_window.rule: games with kickoff strictly after registered_at_utc
evaluation_window.pre_registration_games: never tested; every game with kickoff at or before registered_at_utc is dropped before any score or odds field is parsed. Season scoreboards are read in full only for team ids and feed membership (to learn each season's FBS set); no pre-registration score, line or result enters the metric.

population: FBS-involved games (ESPN college-football scoreboard feed groups=80); completed, not STATUS_FORFEIT; at least 10 hours past kickoff (an operational proxy for 'the game ended at least 6 hours ago'; no ESPN end-time field is used).

classification.fbs_set: a team is FBS in a season if it plays in at least one groups=80-only event (not also in groups=81) that season, from the season's scoreboards (regular weeks 1-17 and postseason weeks 1-3, both feeds) fetched at evaluation time; the division reading verified in scripts/cfb_v6_history_backfill.py
classification.fbs_vs_fcs: exactly one of the two teams is in that season's FBS set
classification.season: calendar year, January and February games belong to the previous season

tilt_rule.lopsided: the closing home spread line (ESPN espn-lines-rule-1 selected home_spread_line) has absolute value >= 28

closing_line.source: ESPN core odds endpoint, fetched at least 10 hours after kickoff
closing_line.selection: espn-lines-rule-1 via trim_item / select_lines imported read-only from scripts/cfb_v6_espn_lines.py (median across non-live providers of the per-provider close value)
closing_line.missing: a game with no selected closing total is skipped, counted and retried on later runs

primary_metric: mean(actual total - closing total) over the qualifying games
primary_decision: one-sided date-clustered bootstrap lower bound (5th percentile) of the mean > 0
secondary_metric: over share = overs / (overs + unders), pushes (actual == closing total) excluded

power.residual_sd_source: the totals diagnosis (sd of actual - closing total about 16); used only for sizing

sample: the first minimum_n qualifying games in (kickoff, event_id) order; one test at that n, so a later run cannot change the sample
below_minimum_n: the evaluator prints INSUFFICIENT N and reports no test
decision_at_minimum_n: tilt SUPPORTED if the one-sided lower bound > 0, else NOT SUPPORTED; both outcomes are reported plainly
expected_duration: about 100-180 qualifying lined games a season, so this is a multi-season test
safety: read-only GET with a generic User-Agent; no order, execute or account endpoint; points and percentages only

evaluator.note: informational; a later bug fix to the evaluator must not change the rule above, which is what the hash pins
